title: Implement square()
learning_objective: Implement a small function that behaves correctly for several inputs.
instructions: Implement square(int value). Submit only the function shown below; do not add main(). Your solution will be checked against several hidden test cases.
hints: The result should be value multiplied by itself.
Your function must work for positive, zero, and negative inputs.
explanation: A function should be correct for the full input contract, not just one example. Hidden tests check several inputs so a hard-coded answer cannot pass.
